nc.description: A 3D rendering shows a vertical cylinder attached to a faceted component, with a larger faceted shape behind it and a horizontal bar in front, all situated on a flat rectangular base.
A segmented white belt wraps around a grey cylindrical hub and extends outward as two parallel flat bands passing between rectangular blocks.
A close-up displays a light grey mechanical linkage consisting of interlocking rectangular blocks and cylindrical pins.
Multiple angled hexagonal rods converge into a central white housing that connects to a single straight hexagonal rod.
Uniformly light-grey mechanical components, including gears, springs, and rods, are arranged in a symmetrical, radial pattern on a white surface.

vc.description: A 3D rendering shows a grey mechanical carriage with a central wheel resting on a linear track.
A gray rendering shows a mechanical assembly featuring a spiked continuous track engaged with a sprocket wheel, located next to an angled, slatted ramp.
A multi-part plastic joint connects several smooth and ribbed cylindrical tubes at a central point.
A complex, grey mechanical assembly featuring gears, springs, and articulated arms rests on a spring-loaded base against a white background.
Disassembled mechanical parts are arranged in a symmetrical pattern around a central gear assembly on a white background.
